model.name: First-class Server config scenario unit (replaces .env)
model.description: A NEW first-class ior:class:Server scenario unit holds the server's identity + config: domain, Let's-Encrypt cert (config/path per domain), ossh config name, and hostname (for later inter-server communication, ties R26 federation). The server reads its config from this Server scenario unit, NOT the .env file - migrating BASE_DOMAIN/LE_DOMAIN/NODE_ENV off .env with back-compat. It AUTO-selects the correct LE cert for the CURRENT domain it publishes share links on (prod.wo-da.de -> prod cert; test.wo-da.de -> test cert), so WODA.prod and WODA.test each use their own Server scenario - verifiable in remoteShells 0.2 (prod) / 0.3 (test), not .env - and share links carry the correct domain + cert per server.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A NEW first-class ior:class:Server scenario unit holds: domain, Let's-Encrypt cert (config/path per domain), ossh config name, hostname (for later inter-server communication).
The server reads its config from the Server scenario unit, NOT the .env file; the current .env (BASE_DOMAIN / LE_DOMAIN / NODE_ENV) is migrated into the Server unit.
The server AUTO-selects the correct Let's-Encrypt cert for the CURRENT domain it publishes share links on (prod.wo-da.de -> prod cert; test.wo-da.de -> test cert).
WODA.prod uses its Server scenario (prod.wo-da.de + prod cert); WODA.test uses its (test.wo-da.de + test cert) - VERIFIABLE via remoteShells 0.2 (prod) + 0.3 (test), NOT .env.
Share links carry the correct domain + cert per server.
The hostname field enables inter-server communication (ties R26 federation).
Migration + back-compat from .env: existing .env values are read once and migrated into the Server unit; the server no longer depends on .env after migration.
